lua: CAM = require('lib.camera'); W = require('lib.world'); LOOK = function(lx, ly, lz, ty, fov, tx, tz) local v = nova.named('van'); local s, c = math.sin(v.heading), math.cos(v.heading); local g = W.height(v.x, v.z); local ax, _, az = v:to_world(tx or 0, 0, tz or 0); CAM.pinned = { v.x + s * lz + c * lx, g + ly, v.z + c * lz - s * lx, ax, g + (ty or 0.85), az, fov or 30 } end; nova.named('van'):teleport(4.5, -150, 0); local s = nova.scene_now(); local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.x, p.z = s:van_point(s.DOOR); s:get_in()

route.capture: side: the left side, the driver seated, on the road
rear-34-idle: three-quarter rear, the tailpipe puffing at idle
pulling-away: R2 from a standstill, more and darker puffs
the chase camera, driving: the van on the road
